commands.label: Compile a reflection-only test host for the released parser and VM
Parse the exact original JASS and execute the original entry point in the actual VM

toolchain: WurstScript v2.1.0 standalone compatible JASS parser and interpreter
semantic_scope: The Wurst JASS parser accepted the exact original source. A fixture passed the parsed call into the compatible execution AST and emulated the game debug callback. Invoking the original entry point produced the greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
